giver.name: Hunter Marek
giver.greeting: Keep your voice down. The wolves are close.

stages.journal: Hunter Marek is losing his traps to a huge alpha wolf haunting Mantle Clearing. He wants it dead.
stages.offer: See those claw marks? An alpha wolf has been wrecking my traps. Kill it and I will make it worth your while.
stages.accept: Good. It prowls the northern edge of the clearing. Mind its pack.
stages.decline: Then watch your step out there.
stages.reminder: Is the alpha dead? I can still hear them howling.

stages.journal: The alpha wolf is dead. Its pelt should prove the deed to Marek.
You hold the alpha wolf's pelt. Bring it to Hunter Marek.

item.name: Alpha Wolf Pelt
item.description: A thick grey pelt, heavy with the musk of the alpha of Mantle Clearing.

stages.journal: Marek paid you for the alpha wolf's pelt. The clearing is a little safer.
stages.text: By the gods, that's the beast! Take this - you've earned every coin.
stages.done: The traps are holding again. Thanks to you.
